# Comfy Sync 3- Talking Image

Generate a talking-head video from a single face photo and an audio clip, with lips and lower-face motion precisely synchronized to the speech. This process outputs one video from one image and one audio input, keeping hands, products, and background completely unchanged. Ideal for product demos, e-commerce introductions, and marketing videos where a static product-holding photo is paired with a voiceover. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_sync_so_talking_image.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: Close-up beauty ad. She holds the Berry Gel Cream tube near her cheek, looks at camera, and speaks softly with subtle lip movement. Keep mouth opening small and natural, no exaggerated wide open mouth. Gentle smile, calm head motion, about 5–6 seconds.
